thread:
Alex M: ran a wide sweep overnight across us-west/eu-west/ap-south for the new 30B q4f16 build. seeing weird cross-region p99 divergence, posting highlights and asking for sizing guidance.

Sana R: pasted numbers below from the bench harness (concurrency is per-GPU thread pool we used). note: all runs include prefix cache enabled except the 'cold' row.

Sana R: ```
region | gpu | kernel | precision | concurrency | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | p99(ms) | qps
us-west | H100-80 | fused_matmul_v2 | q4f16 | 12 | 18 | 42 | 108 | 230
eu-west | A100-80 | default | q4f16 | 8 | 24 | 95 | 310 | 150
eu-west | A100-80 | fused_matmul_v2 | q4f16 | 8 | 20 | 70 | 180 | 170
ap-south | H100-80 | fused_matmul_v2 | q4f16 | 10 | 22 | 58 | 200 | 195
ap-south | H100-80 | fused_matmul_v2 | q8 | 10 | 28 | 90 | 360 | 165
us-west | H100-80 | fused_matmul_v1 | q4f16 | 12 | 20 | 60 | 140 | 210
(also ran cold start on eu-west A100: p99 620ms with model load spikes)
```

Tom H: yikes eu-west A100 default kernel is the problem — fused_matmul_v2 cuts p99 by ~40-50% there. looks like kernel selection matters more on A100 for this model.

Jen W: what does this mean for Dedicated pool sizing? if eu-west p99 at 180 with fused kernel we can aim for concurrency 8/gpu and 25% autoscale headroom; default kernel needs more headroom.

Alex M: rough calc: target 99th SLO = 250ms. For eu-west A100 with fused kernel we can set concurrency target 8 and reserve 1.25x active capacity to hit p99 under typical load spikes. For A100 default kernel we probably need 1.8x or force H100 in reserved pool.

Sana R: adding some ballpark capacity numbers from the simulated peak workload (sustained QPS 9k global, 60/25/15 split us/eu/ap):

Sana R: ```
scenario | region qps | gpu type | concurrency target | gpus needed (base) | gpus w/ 30% headroom
us-west | 5400 | H100-80 | 12 | 26 | 34
eu-west | 2250 | A100-80 (fused) | 8 | 14 | 18
ap-south | 1350 | H100-80 | 10 | 7 | 9
(If A100 default kernel: eu-west gpus needed base -> 26, headroom -> 34)
```

Tom H: takes into account KV cache hit ~45% in us-west which reduces qps to model by ~1.7x effective. in eu we saw cache hit lower (~25%) so capacity is worse there. ops pattern: eu has short bursts from partner integrations.

bench-bot: full bench logs uploaded to S3: https://s3.redwood/bench/1768501234-sweep.tar.gz

Jen W: operational asks: 1) force fused_matmul_v2 in eu-west A100 staging and run 12h soak; 2) re-run the autoscale sim with 40% burst headroom for eu-west (partner SLA); 3) recommend switching new Dedicated eu-west pools to H100 where customers need <250ms p99.

Alex M: agree on the action items. also we should add kernel choice into the model manifest so Dedicated allocator picks kernel-optimized variants automatically.

Sana R: note on quant: q8 looked worse p99 in ap-south — appears quantization noise + kernel interactions amplify tail. stick with q4f16 for now for production pools.

Tom H: proposing to set conservative reserved counts for next quarter: us-west 34 H100s, eu-west 20 H100/A100 fused mix (re-evaluate after soak), ap-south 9 H100s. will drop if 12h soak improves p99.

Alex M: I'll update the sizing spreadsheet and run the autoscale sim with the new kernel constraint. @bench-bot can you kick off the 12h fused soak in eu-west? :thumbsup:

bench-bot: queued job 9842 -> running in eu-west on A100 fleet with fused_matmul_v2, tracker: https://internal/redwood/bench/9842

ops-bot: FYI deploying kernel pinning flag to staging today at 14:00 UTC. rolling canary to 5% nodes.

Jen W: small note for sales: if customers ask for 'guaranteed p99 <250ms eu' tell them H100-backed Dedicated is our recommendation until we finish the A100 fused rollout.

Alex M: thanks — we'll reconvene after soak. action owner list: Alex (sizing sheet + sims), Sana (soak run monitoring), Tom (capacity booking), Jen (customer comms).
